name: profile-page
title: Profile Page
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A person's profile as a glass bento page: an aurora backdrop, one frosted panel recipe in four shapes, and a 24-hour dial that shows their working window live. Use it for team directories, member pages and public profiles.
docs: Named exports: ProfilePage, GlassPanel, WorkdayDial, useLocalTime. `ProfilePage` is the backdrop and 12-column grid; place `GlassPanel`s inside with `shape` (slab, tile, disc, capsule) and column spans. `WorkdayDial` takes `timeZone`, `start`, `end`, `place`, `name`.
